properties.name: Pando aspen stand and Fish Lake, Fishlake National Forest, Utah
properties.description: About 6.6 km box centered on the Pando quaking aspen clone (38.525 N, 111.750 W), including aspen and conifer forest, meadows, and the southwest shore of Fish Lake.

properties.name: Wind River Experimental Forest, Washington (NEON WREF)
properties.description: About 6.6 km box centered on the NEON WREF tower (45.820 N, 121.952 W): old-growth Douglas-fir and western hemlock forest with repeated NEON airborne lidar.

properties.name: Managed forest near Pigeon Springs, Cowlitz County, Washington
properties.description: About 6.6 km box centered at 46.039 N, 122.631 W in managed conifer forest of mixed stand ages, with clearcut harvests during 2026. It lies about 50 km west of Wind River and on the same NISAR track and frame (172, descending, frame 65), which makes it the change-detection site for the NISAR lesson.
